research_mode: EXPLORATORY within SAME ESA Mission1 previously exposed event IDs; does NOT establish independent generalization
goal: Test whether fixed causal prediction innovation and local change add information beyond level deviation; then test HMM marginal time value on the SAME combined observation
preexisting_split: reuse exact V1.5 global-ID-aware chronological split cut indices [431304,593284], no posthoc changes
sampling: 10 min asof, 60 min max staleness, 16point history, evaluation stride4=40min, not official 30s ESA
training_reference: only training partition strictly normal (code==0) in all 16 timepoints of each window, 20k evenly-spaced windows to fit the reference models

risk_components.level: original RobustLevelDeviation on last simultaneous real-channel telemetry readings
risk_components.innovation: existing ForecastRidge model trained on same pure-normal 20k causal windows, predict last reading using prior 8 real windows, report normalized multichannel forecast error
risk_components.local_change: max over channels of absolute latest telemetry value minus median of preceding 8 real samples, normalized by fitted normal residual robust scale
risk_components.calibration: for each risk component, reference empirical CDF on strictly nominal training windows; clamp tail percentile [0,1]
risk_components.risk_state_init: on combined rank risk, train-pure-normal q70 and q95 initialize three ordered risk tiers H / D / R (R check advised, never auto fault)
risk_components.hmm: same prior HMM code and gamma=0.6,memory=0.5,variance floor=0.0036 trained from train normal pseudo-risk-tier sequence; no abnormal→physical state invention

alarm_rules.method: for each model, 99.8th percentile of OFFICIAL NOMINAL validation scores, not test; 3 consecutive 40min windows required
alarm_rules.rare_nominal: negative (separate burden audit), as frozen V1.5 protocol

predeclared_effect_questions: Is the fixed combined static risk AP better than original raw level baseline (not HMM)?
Does adding HMM to the SAME combined 3tier emission preserve/increase AP and official new-onset recall relative to same-tier static and EMA?
Is any false-alarm occupancy reduction achieved without losing all true new event onset?
Do risk tiers remain author-defined rather than physically verified?
forbidden: NEVER select best weights or threshold based on exposed test; NO retuning until new independently frozen event group
Do not interpret risk H/D/R as verified physical health, degradation, failure; R means request human check
Do not claim main HMM successful when event onset recall=0, irrespective of lower normal false alert occupancy
Do not claim this trial is objective calibration of displayed 0-100 health index; expert rated scores are absent
Not official ESA preprocessing; not a real-operator online labeling deployment
Do not use telecommand_36 etc as verified actuator context; anonymized relevance has not been demonstrated
No modification to frozen main or delivery release or original MSF maximum64 budget
